title: SCHEMA — Reference
idiom: bold black-and-cream linocut, set-square and plumb bob
hero_prompt: Bold linocut print in black on cream paper, thick carved shapes with white gouge marks, no fine hatching, flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: seen from the side, a large plain wooden set-square standing upright on a bare table, and beside it a plumb bob hanging perfectly still on a straight line from above, the two together the measure of square and true; solid black shapes, generous empty cream space, a quiet plain workroom wall behind.
icon_prompt: Flat black silhouette icon on a plain white ground, one bold shape, no shading, no gradients, no gloss: a set-square triangle overlapping one plain circle
